examples.explanation: The whole array is already an arithmetic sequence with a common difference of 3, so the longest arithmetic subsequence is [3, 6, 9, 12], of length 4.
The longest arithmetic subsequence is [4, 7, 10] (indices 1, 2, 4), with a common difference of 3. There is no arithmetic subsequence of length 4.
The longest arithmetic subsequence is [20, 15, 10, 5] (indices 0, 2, 4, 5), with a common difference of -5.
